Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our running contract ctr:4600070410 is valid until 2027-06-30 and fixes delivery at 42 days (ctr:4600070410#5.1).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
We would rather be your most predictable customer than your loudest one: the attached call-off schedule gives you level monthly releases of 1,950 pcs with no peaks over 24 months, a firm horizon ahead of your 42-day lead time, no forecast inflation and no parallel enquiries elsewhere during the term - you plan on certainty.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around volume, contract length, lead time.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €32.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units over a 24-month contract and will maintain the 42-day lead time.
Securing this accelerated delivery schedule under our current capacity utilization necessitates the proposed pricing.
As a matter of corporate policy, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
